advancements.ancient_remnants_add.ancien: Collect every research entry and complete the Monolith Codex.
Discover a ruined altar of the Ancient Heart.
advancements.ancient_remnants_add.glory_: Repair the altar, offer a complete Monolith Codex, and awaken the Ancient Heart.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.incom: The Ancient Heart requires a complete Monolith Codex.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.activ: The Ancient Heart awakens above the spire.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.sacri: The Ancient Heart shatters. The codex falls.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page1: [Getting & Repair] The Ancient Heart has a 25% chance to appear in ancient city chests. The broken altar has an empty space at its center; place the Ancient Heart there to repair the site.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page2: [Activation] Hold a Monolith Codex with all research entries completed, stand within the altar area, and Shift + hold right-click for 2 seconds. The codex is consumed and stored in the altar record; Shift prevents normal right-click from opening the codex screen.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page3: [On Activation] The altar repairs itself and clears everything inside the structure; the dormant core appears above the spire; the entire structure becomes indestructible.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page4: [Blessing Boost] Each activated altar increases the specified blessing effects by 100% (capped). Below 3 altars, only within the altar area; 3-8, dimension-wide; 9+, source dimension + target dimensions.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page5: [Create] Disabled with 1-2 altars; with 3-8, chance outputs are x1.5 dimension-wide; with 9+, enabled in the source dimension and target dimensions.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page6: [Sacrifice & Reactivation] After activation, when a player kills a specific mob within the altar area, the Ancient Heart is destroyed and the altar is extinguished; placing the Ancient Heart again reactivates it.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page7: [Other] Inactive Ancient Hearts can be dropped with Silk Touch.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page8: [Altar Harvest] Blessings can also trigger when crops are harvested, no longer limited to player destruction; below 3 altars, only within the altar area; 3-8, dimension-wide; 9+, source dimension + target dimensions. The chance is fixed and does not stack with the number of altars.
